description: This file is a shell script used as a test suite for Git's revision parsing functionality, including tests for various revision specifications like parent revisions, symbols, and edge cases.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev_output
methods.description: Compares the output of git rev-parse commands against expected values.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the test repository.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock (for commit timestamps).

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Outputs a sequence of numbers for testing.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
